intentions.title: Give every non-2xx API response one structured, contract-documented error envelope
intentions.evidence: fallback_controller.ex routes ALL controller error tuples through Barkpark.Content.Errors.to_envelope/2, referencing docs/api-v1.md §Error codes; controllers like tasks_controller.ex and bulldocs_ingest_controller.ex still hand-roll per-endpoint {ok:false, reason:...} / {error:{code,message}} shapes on top of that, but the router-wide fallback guarantees no raw 500/changeset leaks.

intentions.title: Make `bp task` (and its retired bd-shim ancestor) a fully server-backed, race-safe task substrate over HTTP
intentions.evidence: tasks_controller.ex implements 12+ endpoints (ready/prime/index/claim/claim_by_id/close/edges/labels/papers/move) with advisory-lock + CAS-on-epoch/rev semantics, resource-conflict 409s, doc_changed_since_claim fencing, and a `prime` one-call rehydration endpoint explicitly designed to replace 4 calls after context compaction.

intentions.title: Make task hierarchy visible and navigable as a 'rail' — parent/child timelines with drift detection for concurrent agents
intentions.evidence: tasks_controller.ex's rail-l1/rail-l3 machinery: task_parent_id, with_rail_extras, rail_rev ETag comparison, blocked_while_claimed and rail_changed advisory notices, move/2 re-parenting with cycle guards, and child_tasks/graph_show/graph_tasks exposing a task's chronological children and expectation-satisfaction reverse view.

intentions.title: Expose the whole content corpus as a navigable, Obsidian-style reference graph (nodes/edges/orphans/dangling/phantoms)
intentions.evidence: tasks_controller.ex graph_corpus/2 builds a full dataset graph (real + phantom nodes, node budget 2000, truncation reporting) explicitly for 'the Web finder... Obsidian show the whole vault surface'; graph_show/graph_orphans/graph_dangling generalize BFS traversal to any content doc type via Content.Graph.

intentions.title: Let external producers stream and AI-propose paper content over HTTP without breaking the published reader contract
intentions.evidence: bulldocs_ingest_controller.ex supports native-blocks ingest, raw-HTML legacy fallback, single-op and atomic-batch block streaming (apply_paper_block_op(s)) with ifRev optimistic concurrency, and an AI-proposes loop (propose/2) that writes ONLY to a drafts.<slug> twin with mandatory provenance edges, routing approval through the existing draft→publish gate rather than a new state machine.

intentions.title: Keep flat and legacy Studio URLs alive by always funneling them to the canonical scoped /w/:ws/p/:proj/d/:ds/studio path
intentions.evidence: studio_redirect_controller.ex always issues 302 (never 301, since target depends on token+Referer) via ScopeResolver.resolve_scope, preferring Referer workspace continuity over first-membership default, shared across PageController and LegacyRedirectController for a single resolution rule.

intentions.title: Show readers exactly what links to the paper they're reading, using the same indexed graph engine as the Studio editor (not a text scan)
intentions.evidence: paper_backlinks.ex renders 'Used by' (valueref-kind) and 'Linked mentions' sections from Content.Graph.reverse_referencers/2, explicitly NOT a corpus scan, matching the Studio backlinks pane's partition_backlinks/1, fail-closed on out-of-scope/draft-only referencers, HTML-escaped, dark-mode-aware via CSS custom-property fallbacks.
